title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 69: Electronic devices (Set 3)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 3) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Write suitable words to complete the conversation. Sarah: Hey, Tom! I saw a 13.1 box at the entrance this morning. Is that yours? Tom: Hi, Sarah! It's mine. It’s the 13.2 I bought two days ago. Sarah: Wow, it's great! Where did you get it? I’ve been thinking about buying one. Tom: I ordered it online. It was a great deal. It can connect to my phone. Sarah: That’s cool! So, you can control it with your phone? Tom: Yes, exactly. I can also use my phone to control other things, like closing the 13.3 without touching it. Sarah: That sounds amazing! I don't know if our phones can work that way. Tom: The technology is developing every day. Now you can even use a 13.4 to control things without the phone. Sarah: Really? I need to get one.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Electronic devices (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Complete the sentence by changing the form of the word in capitals. Spending too much time on electronic devices can be to your eyes. (HARM)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Electronic devices (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Read the following passage and choose the option that best fits each blank. Using electronic devices for long periods can cause various 14.1 communication technology health management problems. One issue is 14.2 stress fever stomachache strain , which happens when a muscle is overused and gets injured. Poor 14.3 schedule costume posture gesture  while using these devices can make the problem worse. If you sit incorrectly, you might feel pain in your neck or back. Doctors 14.4 suggest deny quit postpone taking breaks every hour to avoid discomfort. They recommend standing up, stretching, and changing positions regularly. You should also sit with your shoulders back and your feet flat on the floor. Ignoring these tips can 14.5 want lead hope try to more serious issues over time, like chronic pain or muscle damage. It’s important to use devices mindfully to protect your body.
